sections.title: The SEO House team
sections.text: Meet the people who work on your website, and open each member's page to see their role and professional links.

sections.title: Team members
sections.text: Are you an SEO specialist who'd like to join the team?

sections.title: Four specialties working on your site together
sections.text: A small team with different specialties works on your project. We read the data first, then each specialist handles their part, and we review the result together before deciding on the next step.

items.heading: SEO
items.label: We identify what your customers search for and which pages deserve work first.

items.heading: Content
items.label: We write pages and articles that answer customers' questions and lead them to get in touch.

items.heading: Technical
items.label: We implement changes on the site and fix whatever stops Google from reading your pages.

items.heading: Performance analysis
items.label: We set up tracking tools and monitor the impact of our work on inquiries and orders.

sections.title: How we work with you
sections.text: We work with companies in Saudi Arabia, Egypt and the UAE. With companies in Saudi Arabia and the UAE, we work remotely, and your project has one point of contact throughout.

items.heading: One point of contact
items.text: They know the details of your website and answer your questions without you having to explain again.

items.heading: We start by understanding your site and goals
items.text: In the first meeting, we review the site with you and agree on the goal, the access we need and how results will be measured.

items.heading: Regular reports on what changed
items.text: What we've done, what changed in the results, and what we'll work on next.
